title: Lubbuu Waaqa tolfamaa Duuba Jirtu
intro: Gaaddidduu baqannaa guddaa abbaa irree keessaa, namni dhokataan kun lafa onaa keessatti eegaa ture. Hogganaan saba filatamaa irbaata waaqummaaf gaara qulqulluu tokkotti yeroo ol ba’u, warra duubatti hafan irratti qormaanni guddaan bu’e. Namni dhuunfaa kun yeroo sana fayyadamee amantaa hawaasa guutuu irra deebi’ee boce. Hogganaan dhugaa qabatee yeroo deebi'u adabbiin addaa fi bara baraa labsame. Lubbuun falmisiisaa fi haxxummaan kun eenyu akka turte hiikuu dandeessaa?
clues: Uummata cunqursaa humna guddaa jalaa bahee mallattoo dinqiitiin imala ture.
Hogganaan isaanii qajeelfama fudhachuuf gara gaaraatti yommuu ol bahu, warra duubatti hafan gidduutti eegeen ture.
Faaya isaanii irraa sibiilota gati jabeessa walitti qabee waan sagalee dhageessisu godheen ture.
Uumama kanaan dhaloota guutuu waaqa isaanii lafa onaa keessatti akka argatan amansiiseera.
Hogganaan sun yeroo deebi'u adda baafamee maaltu gara gowwoomsaa akkasiitti na oofe jedhame.
Addunyaa kana irratti adabbiin koo namni tokkollee akka na hin tuqne ykn natti hin dhihaanne ture, mallattoo salphina ani bara baraan baadhadha.

outcome.answer: Hin tuqamne, bara baraan 'no contact' jechuun balaaleffame.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
